reader.requirement: At --std 85, in a report with a PAGE clause, no line of the report heading may be presented above the HEADING integer: an absolute LINE above HEADING is in error, and a relative first line is placed at HEADING + integer - 1 (§1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR3 b), so LINE PLUS 0 is in error; with NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE the same upper limit holds on the heading's own page.

reader.notes: GroupLimits gives the report heading the HEADING integer as its upper limit. ScreenReportGroupLines refuses an absolute line above it and, through RelativeFirstLineFloor, a relative first line placed above it, and the runtime places the relative first line at HEADING + integer - 1. Every legal and refusal probe matched the 1985 rule.

refuter.evidence: Rendered the printed Table 1 (1985 PDF page 610, XIII-28; the transcription page is blank): upper limit rule 1 applies to every permissible row with a PAGE clause (A R and R, with absolute, relative, NEXT PAGE or no NEXT GROUP); NP is not a permissible RH sequence. Probes at --std 85 (gen/mkq.py, reader's rh5a harness): q1 HEADING omitted (XIII.3.8.4 GR2a: 1) RH LINE 1 -> P01 L01; q2 HEADING omitted, RH LINE PLUS 2 -> L02 (1 + 2 - 1, GR3b); q3 LINE 4 then LINE 2 (second absolute line above HEADING 3) refused COBOL2199 (order and upper limit); q4 RH LINE 3 ON NEXT PAGE refused (NP not in the RH table); q5 LINE NUMBER IS PLUS 1 NEXT GROUP PLUS 1 -> L03, D1 L06; q6 A R with NEXT GROUP 5 -> R1 L03 R2 L04; q7 LINE 0 refused (COBOL2386 + COBOL2199 above upper limit); q8 R then A (LINE PLUS 1, LINE 2) refused. With the reader's rh5b/rh5e/rh5g refusals, no RH line reaches above HEADING.
